Country.evidence_source: Two researchers initially recruited participants from Harare using an opportunistic method of sampling. Once data collection in Zimbabwe was complete, the same two researchers recruited an age-matched sample of Zimbabwean women in London using a snowball-sampling technique.

section_summary.extract_value: This procedural section describes a single study conducted in two locations (Harare, Zimbabwe and London, UK) recruiting Zimbabwean women. Recruitment used opportunistic sampling in public spaces in Harare and snowball sampling in London; surveys were administered in English as paper-and-pencil questionnaires with counterbalanced scale order, and participants provided informed consent and were not remunerated.
section_summary.evidence_source: Key sentences: 'Because English is an official language in Zimbabwe and widely used by Zimbabweans, the survey was presented in English in both settings.' 'Two researchers initially recruited participants from Harare using an opportunistic method of sampling.' 'Once data collection in Zimbabwe was complete, the same two researchers recruited an age-matched sample of Zimbabwean women in London using a snowball-sampling technique.' 'All participants provided informed consent and completed paperand-pencil surveys in which the order of presentation of the scales was counterbalanced.'
